name: Weekly customer health watcher
why: Runs the weekly health check from account usage, matching the weekly account health run workflow.

name: Monthly renewal watcher
why: Lists renewals due in the next 90 days with the risk on each, the first step of the renewal cycle.

name: Customer onboarding keeper
why: Finds where each week's new customers stall in the first 30 days, the stuck signals from the onboarding skill.

name: New customer onboarding sequence writer
why: Drafts a welcome email and text series that pairs with the first-win plan.

name: Make onboarding instructions match the product
why: Checks that setup guides match the real product, so no step in the onboarding plan is invented.

name: Subscription churn watcher
why: Tracks monthly cancels and whether last month's fix worked, alongside the churn reasons breakdown prompt.

name: Cancel reason save planner
why: Matches one save option to each cancel reason, the core of the fair cancel flow skill.

name: Subscription cancel flow builder
why: Builds the cancel flow screens and a failed-payment plan from your portal options.

name: Win-back flow builder
why: Times win-back messages to how former customers actually come back.

name: Discount and price change checker
why: Checks a planned price change or retention discount against margin before the announcement goes out.

name: Prepare an enterprise account plan
why: Maps buyer roles and risks for a large account, useful input for a success plan and quarterly review.

name: Angry customer reply writer
why: Drafts a calm reply to an unhappy customer before a save call.
